mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_unit WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND parent_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND enabled=TRUE) children,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND (source_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) OR target_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}))) relations,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_position WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND organization_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND enabled=TRUE) positions,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_assignment a JOIN tenant_organization_position p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.position_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND p.organization_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND a.enabled=TRUE AND a.starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) activeAssignments,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_leader l JOIN tenant_organization_assignment a ON a.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND a.id=l.assignment_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND l.organization_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND a.enabled=TRUE AND a.starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) leaders

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_organization_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND version=#{version}

mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_organization_position SET name=#{name},enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_organization_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND position_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND enabled=TRUE AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) id,BIN_TO_UUID(member_id) memberId,BIN_TO_UUID(position_id) positionId,starts_at startsAt,ends_at endsAt,enabled,version FROM tenant_organization_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} ORDER BY starts_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_organization_assignment(tenant_id,id,member_id,position_id,starts_at,ends_at) SELECT #{__verifiedTenant},UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}),UUID_TO_BIN(#{memberId}),UUID_TO_BIN(#{positionId}),#{startsAt},#{endsAt} FROM tenant_member m JOIN tenant_organization_position p ON p.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND m.id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{memberId}) AND m.enabled=TRUE AND p.id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{positionId}) AND p.enabled=TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_organization_assignment SET ends_at=#{endsAt},enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_organization_leader WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND assignment_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(l.organization_id) organizationId,BIN_TO_UUID(l.assignment_id) assignmentId FROM tenant_organization_leader l JOIN tenant_organization_assignment a ON a.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND a.id=l.assignment_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND a.enabled=TRUE AND a.starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_organization_leader(tenant_id,organization_id,assignment_id) SELECT #{__verifiedTenant},UUID_TO_BIN(#{organizationId}),a.id FROM tenant_organization_assignment a JOIN tenant_organization_position p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.position_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND a.id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{assignmentId}) AND p.organization_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{organizationId}) AND a.enabled=TRUE AND a.starts_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_organization_leader WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND organization_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{organizationId}) AND assignment_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{assignmentId})
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(m.id) id,a.display_name displayName FROM tenant_member m JOIN identity_account a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND m.enabled=TRUE AND a.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY a.display_name,m.id
